notes: The approved Runway task ID was provided by the user, but the exact Runway image could not be directly ingested in this environment. A locally generated surrogate style board matching board A was used as the visual anchor for all downstream generations.
All text and numerals are intentionally absent. Godot should draw live text.
Icon assets were exported as 24x24 PNGs because the requested filename list did not include separate 16x16 and 24x24 variants. They can be downscaled to 16x16 if needed.
08.7 verified all nine canonical HUD icons in game_ui.gd; removed 18 unused 16/24 derivative variants, retaining source and original 24px canonical PNGs.
issues: Several icons remain more plaque-like than pure silhouette marks; the smallest 16x16 use case may benefit from a future simplification pass.
The prompt strip interior is slightly more saturated green than ideal and may warrant a flatter repaint if stricter low-contrast behavior is required.
The normal/hover/pressed button states are visually distinct, but the pressed-depth change is subtle.

Runway-approved board A remains externally hosted. This asset pack used a locally generated visual surrogate; no exact Runway HUD task media was imported. Per-element Runway task IDs are intentionally null.
